messages.subject: Error in plot_BioGeoBEARS_results

This may be a typical beginner's question, but I am trying to run the Psychotria example dataset with the script provided by Nick and when I get to the "plot_BioGeoBEARS_results" function for the results_object, I get an error saying "'names' attribute [5] must be the same length as the vector [4]". Any ideas what might be going on? Thank you in advance!!!

Sara

messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Error in plot_BioGeoBEARS_results
parts:
Yeah, plot issues should be fixed by sourcing the new plotting .R file, listed in the example script.  I improved some of the plotting stuff a few weeks back.

At some point I will put BioGeoBEARS on github and do updates there, but I need to get all the documentation done and get an official big update on CRAN first.  So for now the best thing is to just use the source() commands in the example script to get the latest updates.  Those who wish to have a "stable" version that doesn't change should save the .R files to a local directory and source() them locally.

Cheers!
Nick
